name: Return to Jahan
summary: You carry finished leather goods from Thunder Bluff back to Jahan Hawkwing at the Crossroads. The trip introduces travelers to the Horde’s wind rider routes between Mulgore and the Barrens, after they bring hides to Ahanu, the skinner in Thunder Bluff.

sections.title: Wings Over Kalimdor
sections.body: Tal, the wind rider master on Thunder Bluff’s central mesa, arranges flights across central Kalimdor. For many travelers, this is their first ride on a trained wind rider. A rider can take you to another settlement once you have met its wind rider master, such as Devrak at the Crossroads. The beasts cross leagues that would otherwise mean a dangerous journey overland through the Red Rocks and northern Barrens.

sections.title: Commerce of the Crossroads
sections.body: Jahan Hawkwing trades from the Crossroads, where hunters, scouts, and mercenaries gather each day. The flight also carries goods between the settlements. Hides sent to Ahanu on Thunder Bluff’s high rises are made into durable armor and equipment, then flown back to the Barrens crossroads to supply the Horde’s growing frontier efforts.

faq.answer: Jahan Hawkwing is a tauren merchant at the Crossroads in the Barrens. He buys and sells leather goods, including gear made by Thunder Bluff artisans from raw beast hides.

faq.q: Why do I need to take a wind rider back to the Crossroads?
faq.answer: The wind rider carries finished leather goods to Jahan and introduces travelers to the flight network. Tal in Thunder Bluff can send riders only to settlements already connected to the roost, such as Devrak’s at the Crossroads.
Ahanu is a leatherworker and skinner on the high rises of Thunder Bluff. He takes raw skins from Barrens hunters and crafts them into finished goods to be sent back for sale.
Devrak is the orcish wind rider master at the Crossroads. He manages the roost connecting the Barrens with Horde strongholds such as Orgrimmar and Thunder Bluff.

faq.q: Can you use a wind rider without speaking to the destination master first?
faq.answer: No. A traveler can ride only to outposts where they have already met the local wind rider master and established a connection between the roosts.

faq.q: What happens after returning the leather goods to Jahan?
faq.answer: Returning the leather goods to Jahan completes the courier chain between Mulgore and the Barrens. Travelers learn how air travel works and can continue helping the Crossroads garrison and merchants.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you rely on wind rider routes linking Mulgore, Durotar, and the Barrens. They bind the Horde’s central Kalimdor territories together.
As a tauren, you can see how trade links Mulgore tanners with Barrens outposts and supports the Horde’s frontier.
